name: Rustbark Tree
description: A colony timber tree with a lime-green crown and rust-brown bark.
role: The main timber source of the frontier. Cutting it yields logs for crafting and quests.

artBrief.silhouette: Round crown on a short trunk; reads as a tree at 16×16.
artBrief.detail: Leaf clusters in three greens and visible bark lines on the trunk.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Lime #abfa00 and #97c92c crown, brown #944f00 and #c07f35 trunk.
